Box3D dependency pins and reuse provenance

6 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
On this page ↓
Selected spike dependenciesSource and notice inventoryCurrent adopted source and patch setJuly baseline patches (historical)Reproduction pins kept separateUpgrade ownership and procedure

Current baseline: Box3D 336263320469e5e9febfe18697ab562488f7e97a (October 28, 2026), promoted by the Web Showcase W0 refresh. The July desktop qualification remains historical and build-specific. See the upgrade record and current evidence. The P0.4 inventory below records the original dependency/reuse decision; its July pin and patch receipts are retained as provenance.

Recorded 2026-10-30 for task t_959ce076efb449df (P0.4), board b_cdde1cdfea104035. This records source/dependency decisions for the native spike; no upstream implementation is vendored by this documentation change.

Selected spike dependencies#

Component Immutable source Disposition
Box3D engine and public C headers erincatto/box3d@d421e45c828f6f853a145f726f0b9425d31146eb Selected native-spike engine pin. Compile one engine instance and include its exact private headers only in the compatibility shim.
Snapshot shim reference pdaddyo/rollback-in-a-box@9e1fe882a0ea4eb52e160d5754a752580b4db462, core/src/rollback_shim.c and core/include/box3d_rollback/rollback_shim.h Selected starting source for isolated C compatibility code. Ownership, loader failure, event buffers and complete-state digest need explicit work; the existing slot API is not a finished adapter.
godot-cpp godotengine/godot-cpp@e83fd0904c13356ed1d4c3d09f8bb9132bdc6b77 Upstream reproduction only, resolved from its godot-4.5-stable tag. Not a dependency of the proposed direct Odin/C runtime.
Godot executable 4.7.1.stable.official.a13da4feb on local macOS arm64 Observed upstream headless-test environment, not a new project toolchain lock.

Pinning selects an auditable starting point, not a claim that the current shim already meets Gate A or that every pair of supported builds agrees. The two framework adapters use the same engine/shim source and configuration.

The original upstream setup script trusts an existing dependency directory without verifying its revision. The Odin build must instead verify the exact commit/content hash, precision, SIMD settings and compiler flags. A branch or tag name alone is insufficient. The native build manifest now records source/content pins, applied patches and resolved simulation/toolchain identities; the earlier P1.1 instruction is completed.

For provenance checks, the inspected original shim files have these SHA-256s:

File at rollback-in-a-box@9e1fe882 SHA-256
core/src/rollback_shim.c 3553c8e430d3561230be509803dc3c4e3cfcf4e66442e3d7033fe99fd52ef921
core/include/box3d_rollback/rollback_shim.h 992c796ac3b6c79580992378ee10ee4a6dcd3b962c1ef557233b546aee0ab24e

These identify the reference files before local modifications. Record subsequent changes as a patch against that source rather than presenting a modified shim as an unmodified upstream file.

Source and notice inventory#

Source Inspected notice Reuse boundary
Box3D LICENSE and engine source headers MIT, copyright 2026 Erin Catto; preserve individual file headers as recorded. Engine/public headers/private snapshot code may be the pinned native dependency. Retain source notices and distributed license text.
Box3D src/qsort.h Embedded MIT notice, copyright 2013, 2017 Alexey Tourbin. Preserve this embedded notice; the root engine notice does not replace it.
Box3D src/verstable.h Embedded MIT notice, copyright 2023–2025 Jackson L. Allan. Preserve the embedded notice when distributing the engine/source or derived runtime package.
rollback-in-a-box LICENSE MIT, copyright 2026 Paul Barrass. Preserve with reused C shim/header or adapted generator code. The shim's lack of a per-file copyright header is not a reason to discard the repository notice.
godot-box3d LICENSE MIT, copyright 2026 Mark Arneman. Reference-only during the spike. If compatibility/query code is later ported, preserve this notice and the exact source/patch provenance.
box3d-godot root LICENSE, addon LICENSE and Godot source SPDX headers Root MIT notice names Erin Catto. Packaged addon explicitly names Stink-O for the extension and Erin Catto for the engine; source names box3d-godot contributors under MIT. Editor/custom-node reference only until later selective reuse. Preserve all applicable engine/extension/contributor notices for any port.
godot-cpp LICENSE.md MIT, copyright 2017-present Godot Engine contributors. Reproduction dependency only. Include its notice if redistributing reproduction artifacts or later linking it; direct Odin/C integration does not need it.
multi-box-3d 987f4ca44d0065676f17cab35edad57fcbb63b13 No root license/notice or game-wide licensing statement located in tracked files. addons/godotsteam/license.md covers that separate addon. Build/run and inspect as the original behavioral reference; do not copy its game implementation/assets into odin_godot based on the unrelated addon notice. Write the Odin scenario independently.

The inventory was checked against pinned tracked source and file headers, not only GitHub's license badge. The missing game-wide notice does not block the chosen engine and shim dependency, which have their own recorded source notices.

Box3D's library target also builds the included sorting/hash-table headers above. Its sample tree contains other third-party components, and enabling profiling can fetch Tracy. Keep sample/benchmark/UI/profiling fetches outside the minimal native library build; if additional code is enabled or distributed, extend this inventory to that actual dependency closure. Source-only references and locally built upstream demos do not mean all of their dependencies are adopted by Odin.

The original P0.4 plan deferred production notices until adoption. The adopted closure is now recorded in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and each Native manifest. Preserve these and individual embedded headers in source/binary distributions, together with the repository's Apache-2.0 notices; separate upstream MIT components are not relabelled as repository-owned code.

Current adopted source and patch set#

The current engine tree is 50877041b7e4de95ff0b6c194182aa50d453b736, with git-archive SHA-256 a9143675b297bb6c6f3d031d1bdf5c265d8642139eea26f265958066bd947935. engine_patches is empty: upstream rounds block allocator strides to alignment, packs compound geometry at aligned offsets, and replaces the old broadphase with paired nodes/parents/proxies. Lifecycle tests retain alignment/free-list, compound ownership and last-moved-proxy destruction regressions.

The rollback reference pin remains unchanged. Its C shim is adapted by rollback_shim_box3d_33626332.patch (SHA-256 92cc54f8c2dfc27de6d09f92accebbb5f6e8356099c4b75ac6bf03227f63568d), whose declared output and reversed upstream preimage are verified by the build driver. It changes private registry/replay-header/SIMD access. The copied header and all original reference hashes remain recorded in dependency.json. Local wrapper/snapshot/recovery code remains independently hashed. License text and original notices are retained.

The admitted backend explicitly selects SIMD width4 through upstream's runtime dispatch API. Compiler-resolved macros record the actual available implementation; the old global B3_SIMD_WIDTH macro is no longer assumed. Scalar/web execution and browser compatibility need their own results. Build/target identities and logical solver version4 reject old images; fresh bootstrap is required.

July baseline patches (historical)#

The verified motion NativeV2 Release manifest records ABI1 and these exact changes to the selected engine. The copied rollback shim/header retain the original file hashes above (shim_patches=[]); local owned snapshots, trusted recovery, motion and API wrappers are separately hashed repository code.

Engine patch SHA-256 Purpose
block_allocator_alignment.patch 4e1c5c3f567cfbc06987123bc3528a1fe546493faf6db4d4d43b3ac878c90677 memcpy free-list pointer access for unaligned element strides, preserving layout/order.
compound_geometry_alignment.patch d81f1b8d8488c64d4ca9d3044d64a89cebe78084d2c39b890aedcda8cba531d1 Typed hull/mesh blob alignment, including odd instance counts and recorded padding/offsets.
broadphase_rebuild.patch f9f69900eb955639745705f057bc838a2284634ff5006c3a2db8bcdbe34b3df6 Rebuild dynamic/kinematic trees before zero-move early return; preserve nonzero-move task ordering.

Pinned Box3D tree 6ad02fc909b70c0c2f4c7d6c1bfa6c8dcfd53f7a, git-archive SHA f423100def3aed95b6c653f42bda276a6c830a15163cb36b71c83536dd8e48f9; rollback reference tree 7cefe9ae72bd39788473bb318d160fca7eee8a91, git-archive SHA f2f2a2488a1d88d4eb79f448a627b2adc820e36697d07c65a949551aea8e279d. These are the manifest's git-archive content identities, not automatically the checksum of a compressed download. Archive caches must use their declared exact transport bytes/checksums. Per-file patch base/output hashes and the full local source closure remain in the Native manifest referenced by Gate C.

They are not the engine revision used by the native spike. See reuse-matrix.md and upstream-baseline.md for dependency differences and actual test results.

Upgrade ownership and procedure#

The odin_godot maintainer responsible for the shared Box3D backend owns the engine pin, private-header shim, binding ABI, snapshot/digest version and release compatibility table together. Upstream is not responsible for preserving the private API. The same owner signs off changes affecting both sibling adapters; Kit and Replay adapter owners review their respective transaction contracts. This establishes repository responsibility without assigning a new person or service account.

An upgrade is one explicit reviewed change following upgrade.md: record candidate pins/notices/patches/toolchains; version incompatible boundaries; validate private C/Odin ABI and full solver/source-free/malformed/rollback paths; re-earn distinct Kit and Replay transaction/network/recovery/export gates; rerun applicable scoped CPU/memory/lifecycle evidence; invalidate derived caches and publish migration/release limits. The historical100/500-body spike benchmark is not an admission or performance guarantee for the current35-body profile.

The pins remain fixed; this documentation does not upgrade them or promise compatibility beyond the exact tested builds and targets.
